a.text: Sticking to our agreement: I'll operate until the reserve hits 8, then take exactly 4. Storms make every round risky, so let's both operate now and reach 8 fast. If a leak happens I'll tell you what I see, and I'll announce any change of plan before I make it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
